title: Implement diagnostics for Rust link persistent-state errors
description: Robustness review of wm48 found public LinkPersistentStateError lacks Display and std::error::Error, unlike existing public link errors. This prevents downstream persistence coordinators from preserving actionable error context. Add stable messages/source behavior and tests.
notes: Added stable Display and Error implementations for public LinkPersistentStateError plus diagnostic coverage. Link tests/clippy pass.
